Scope and source ownership

  1. Paper III-F's existing p3f:thm:v180-exact-finite-quartic-scalar-action remains a valid 14-mode restricted scalar comparison action. Added source labels distinguish the full untruncated scalar PDE and its off-band force. Its mathematical finite-band no-go assumes nonzero quartic coupling, frozen round metric, one real scalar, no canceling source; does not falsify a source-licensed finite Galerkin action.
  2. The stationary-instability theorem is a full isolated real-scalar fluctuation statement. A previously sampled mixed degree-two Hessian with rational coefficients is not a full stationary solution (E_6 equation residual -81/70000). Coupled gravity/gauge, time-dependent and actual physical states are not resolved.
  3. Same-action odd-harmonic generation inherits an explicit nonzero initial field dipole and a locally analytic full evolution; it is not inferred from the primitive position test E_1^x.
  4. Paper II-C's F_K scalar coordinate matrix algebra and evaluation POVM are mathematical reciprocal-position test comparisons, not the original 15-dimensional momentum H_1 carrier. No independent test host, physical guard or apparatus is generated by algebraic closure.
  5. Paper IV-A's coordinate Lie group, four-setting tomography and orientation no-go are mathematical coherent-control/readout capacities. No actual quantum control Hamiltonian DYN, performed instrument PROC, detector or event history is established.
  6. The source-defined sharp test frontier SF_{Lambda_F} remains a separate OPEN occurrence condition; the scalar instability shell condition is not its replacement.
